features.name: Leaf health analysis
features.data_source: Uploaded leaf image and built-in disease knowledge base; optional PlantVillage training pipeline; bundled rice leaf dataset
features.dataset_type: User image + local reference labels; 120-image rice dataset with three labelled classes
features.model: Colour/texture feature pipeline; MobileNetV2 training pipeline available
features.limitations: Preliminary indication only until a trained model is validated with independent local field images and published metrics. The bundled rice dataset is small and not sufficient alone for production.

features.name: Disease risk
features.data_source: Synthetic monsoon and disease-risk scenarios generated with a fixed seed
features.limitations: The model is illustrative and must be retrained with verified local outbreak data for production.

features.name: Crop recommendation
features.limitations: Reference profiles are planning examples, not a regional agronomy survey.

features.name: Soil health and fertilizer guidance
features.data_source: User-entered NPK and pH against broad agronomic ranges
features.limitations: Use accredited laboratory soil tests before making fertilizer decisions.

features.name: Yield and risk estimate
features.data_source: Crop baseline yield assumptions plus user-entered soil and climate values
features.limitations: Pests, seed variety, irrigation, management and local conditions can materially change yield.

features.name: Live weather and forecast alerts
features.data_source: OpenWeather Current Weather and 5-day/3-hour Forecast APIs when configured
features.model: Server-side API integration plus transparent alert rules
features.limitations: Requires OPENWEATHER_API_KEY, network access and location permission; forecasts are cached and alerts are not official warnings.

features.name: My plants, dashboard and scan history
features.data_source: Farmer-entered plant details plus private leaf-analysis, appointment and order records
features.model: No prediction model; access-controlled record aggregation
features.limitations: Photos are access-controlled application uploads, not a training dataset; only the signed-in farmer can retrieve their scan history.

features.name: Plant doctor directory and booking
features.data_source: Built-in verified doctor profiles and user appointments
features.limitations: Demo doctor information must be replaced with verified operational data before deployment.

features.name: Consultation and voice chat
features.data_source: User messages stored per accepted appointment
features.model: No generative model in the appointment room
features.limitations: Voice conversion depends on browser speech APIs; appointment access is restricted to its farmer and doctor.

features.name: Agri Assistant
features.data_source: Built-in multilingual crop, disease and medicine knowledge
features.limitations: General education only; it does not replace an agricultural expert.

features.name: Medicine shop and orders
features.data_source: Built-in medicine catalogue and farmer cart/order records
features.limitations: Catalogue, prices and fulfilment are demonstration data.
